description: This Java class 'EngineSnifferPanel' manages the UI components and logic for an engine sniffer tool, including chart display, image panels, controls, and event handling for engine data visualization.

classes.name: EngineSnifferPanel
classes.description: Main class for engine sniffer UI, handling chart display, controls, and interactions.

classes.name: ImageOrderComparator
classes.description: Comparator for ordering image names, prioritizing certain prefixes for display order.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Sets the paused state and updates the pause button text.

methods.name: displayChart
methods.description: Parses engine chart data and updates the UI images accordingly.

methods.name: getInsertIndex
methods.description: Determines the insertion index for a new image based on sorted order.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves the current main panel as an image file with a filename based on RPM and MAF sensor values.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Creates an UpDownImage with color coding based on the name prefix.

methods.name: reloadFile
methods.description: Reloads the chart from the repository and resets the scroll control.

methods.name: getTabSelectedListener
methods.description: Returns an ActionListener that focuses the command field when the tab is selected.

methods.name: setOutpinListener
methods.description: Registers a callback to update physical pin info for channels.

methods.name: resetImagePanel
methods.description: Resets the image panel to contain only the crank image.
